The change has one real problem: `weeks` has no upper bound.

`CreateWeeklyBooking::handle` accepts any `weeks` value up to `u32::MAX`. It rejects only 0, then builds `slots` as a `Vec<Slot>` with one entry per week (lines 74-79). The route parses `weeks` straight from the form (`src/web/bookings/routes.rs:92-94`), so a guest can post `weeks=4000000000`. That allocates a vector of billions of slots and then runs `booking_at` for each, so the request can exhaust memory or hang. It also books years of weekly slots. The steering says the command's `handle` decides what is allowed, so the limit belongs there, as a failure variant such as `TooManyWeeks`.
